note:
Thirty vectors for art-764-solo-401k-vs-sep-ira (APEXPORT-112). Four live Apex result vectors plus 26 boundary vectors covering all ten comparators in the ported kernel, each comparator with one pair at the exact boundary and one just past it.

PROVENANCE. `apex_observed` is NOT hand-derived: it is the window._lastResult produced by executing the calcSERetirement() function extracted verbatim from the inline <script> of https://apexlogics.org/tools/112-solo-401k-vs-sep-ira/ , fetched 2026-10-13T19:32:36Z, 28238 bytes, sha256 F059A17B9AB3D28661D511FEC6B2C97BE1D7A53016C712C849DDCD4B3241F560. The harness is scratch/APEXPORT-112/tmp/apex-run.mjs logic, re-hosted in tmp/build-fixtures.mjs; it stubs only document.getElementById and window, then calls the page's own code.

DELTAS. `apex_vs_kernel` is (apex_usd * 100 - kernel_cents) per field, unit cents. 28 of 30 vectors are sub-cent, the residue of Apex's IEEE-754 intermediates against the kernel's floor-divided integer cents (DIFFERS row D3). The one MATERIAL divergence is simple_ira_employee_cents = +100000 on every age-50+ vector: Apex hardcoded a $5,000 SIMPLE IRA catch-up where the official 2026 figure is $4,000 (DIFFERS row D1). Two vectors refuse (bnd-c11 zero net income, bnd-c13b tax year 2027) and record what Apex answered anyway (DIFFERS rows D2 and D6). The winner agrees with Apex on all 28 computed vectors.

GOLDEN HASHES. `golden_hash` is bare lowercase hex SHA-256 over the JCS-canonical (RFC 8785 §3.2) preimage of {policy_parameters, output_payload}, computed with chaingraph/kernels/_hash.mjs byte-for-byte (fetched this run, sha256 EF6FD5A1F28131DCE8CA5EA3ADCD1662E93CEC682B7CECB3759A9647B6A56F04). human_sign_off: PENDING (draft for a trusted builder).

Amounts are integer cents with floor division; the Apex source page used IEEE-754 doubles and rounded for display, so sub-cent intermediates differ by construction.
